artificial intelligence is better at solving problems that are more complex and require more computation, and natural intelligence is better at problems that require more creativity and flexibility.

the question of "when will artificial intelligence outcompete natural intelligence?"

artificial intelligence can be used to outcompete natural intelligence under certain circumstances.

artificial intelligence is still far away from outcompeting natural intelligence, and the most likely scenario would be that artificial and natural intelligence will coexist.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the current technology and algorithm of artificial intelligence can not be used to replace human intelligence, and that artificial intelligence can only be used to replace some of the functions that human intelligence is responsible for, but can not replace human intelligence itself.
, in the current situation, artificial intelligence can outcompete natural intelligence in some situations, but it is not the case for all situations.
